display_long_description:
Haymaker is a physics-first VR combat brawler built around authentic body mechanics, reactive AI, and replayable close-quarters fights.

Step into a combat sandbox where every grab, grapple, block, and strike is driven by physics-based interaction. The core melee system is fully playable, making each encounter feel physical, responsive, and different.

[media]

Use gesture-based kicks and knees to deal damage, create space, interrupt attacks, or control multiple opponents in a crowded fight.

[media]

Combat is designed to be readable and reactive. Incoming-attack indicators help players recognize enemy strike intent in real time, giving them a chance to counter, block, dodge, or intercept attacks before they land. Fighters use active ragdoll characters, so enemies and teammates react dynamically to impact, gravity, collisions, and environmental objects.

[media]

Turn everyday objects into tools for combat, or spawn dedicated weapons. Grab, swing, stab, throw, and disarm using the same physics-driven interactions as hand-to-hand combat. Weapons react to momentum, impact, and positioning, allowing fights to shift naturally between fists, improvised objects, and heavier melee tools.

[media]

Adaptive AI - teammates and enemies can predict target positions, choose suitable attacks, and improvise with nearby objects, creating more dynamic encounters.

[media]

Join our Discord for the latest news and updates: https://discord.gg/s8E6Gg4BHe
